# Vision — Proto Analytics

## Goals
Give founders a one-page analytics dashboard that answers "what changed this week" in under ten seconds.

## Non-goals
No custom SQL editor, no multi-tenant billing, no mobile app before the web dashboard ships.

## 2. Principles

### 2.1 Speed first
Every page renders under 200 ms on a cold cache.

### 2.3 Evidence over claims
A feature is done when a simulated user has exercised it and the evidence is hashed.
